name: H01_gorehorn_raider_raid_deals_two_to_a_creature
note: Gorehorn Raider: 'Raid — When this creature enters, if you attacked this turn, this creature deals 2 damage to any target.' P0 attacks with a 0/2 Scout (it deals no combat damage), then casts the Raider in the second main phase with exactly its cost ({4}{R}) and aims the trigger at the opponent's 3/3: that creature has exactly 2 damage marked (not 1, not 3) and survives; nobody's life changes.
